# Sample Markdown

This is a sample markdown file used for testing the parser.

## Features
- Headings
- Lists
- [Links](https://github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph)
- `Code blocks`

### Specialized Support
We are testing how deep the heading levels can go.

#### Level 4 Heading
Some nested content here.

```python

    print("Hello from markdown")
```
